queer_characters.name: Franky Winter
queer_characters.notes: After an intimate encounter with Ballas, Franky explicitly states he is uncertain about his sexuality and did not feel uncomfortable; the film presents a deliberately unlabeled, questioning arc without rushing him to define himself.

queer_characters.name: Ray
queer_characters.notes: Franky's father, described in the text as gay, having come out later in life; he offers supportive, nuanced advice to Franky about not rushing to define himself.

queer_characters.name: Ballas
queer_characters.notes: Ballas participates in the intimate incident with Franky but then spreads false rumors to protect himself; his own sexuality is never stated in the text, and his actions harm Franky, making his portrayal ambiguous.
queer_characters.contest_notes: The source text confirms Ballas took part in the encounter but says nothing about how he identifies; his denial and rumor-spreading leave any reading of his queerness as interpretation rather than established.

contributor_notes: Franky's arc is intentionally left unlabeled/questioning per the source; avoid pinning a specific orientation on him.
